# Awesome Weather Kits

## Libraries

- ![stars](https://example.com/stars.svg) [Cloudcount](https://github.com/example-owner/cloudcount) - Counts clouds in photos.
- [![CI](https://example.com/ci.svg)](https://ci.example.com/cloudcount) [Rainmeter Lite](https://rain.example.com) - Measures rain.
- 🌧️ [Drizzle](https://github.com/example-owner/drizzle) - Forecasts light rain.
- :free: [Breeze](https://breeze.example.com) - Wind maps.
- **[Thunder Kit](https://github.com/example-owner/thunder-kit)** - Bold name, still an item.
- _[Fog Lamp](https://foglamp.example.com)_ - In italics.
- [**Hail Tracker**](https://hail.example.com) - Bold inside the link.
- [Mist][mist-link] - Written as a reference.

[mist-link]: https://github.com/example-owner/mist
